title: Palletize with a gantry
summary: Drive a three-axis gantry through a computed 2 by 2 pattern to stack eight boxes in two layers on a pallet.
scope: Passing means your program behaved correctly in the simulator on this computer. It says nothing about a real machine, its timing or its safety.
objectives: Command three axes with integer counts and let every move wait until each axis has arrived.
Choose the place of each box from its number: the slot in the layer and the height of the layer.

stages.title: Objective
stages.body: In src/Palletizing.st, send one box, lower the pad onto it, grip, lift, travel in X and Z to the next place of a 2 by 2 pattern, lower to the pallet or to the first layer, release, lift and return. Do it for eight boxes and light Green after the eighth.
stages.checkpoint: Arrived compares the three axes with their commands, and each state waits for it.

stages.title: Predict
stages.body: Before running, follow the head: it rises above a full second layer before anything crosses the belt, comes down onto the box, rises again, travels over the slot in X and Z, and comes down onto the pallet for the first layer or onto the first layer for the second.
stages.checkpoint: Four boxes sit on the pallet, then four on top of them.

stages.title: Edit
stages.body: Correct this starter omission, save it, then press {{ui:learn.check}}: The starter commands no position, so the gantry stays on the floor; send each box, grip it, place it on the pallet in a 2 by 2 pattern of two layers, and light Green after the eighth.
stages.checkpoint: {{ui:learn.check}} reports the scenario of this lesson as passed.

stages.title: Run
stages.body: Press {{ui:learn.check}}. ZPLC runs your saved program against the scenario of this lesson, with the plant answering your outputs, and lists every assertion that failed. To watch the plant move, press {{ui:toolbar.run.label}} (F5) and open the {{ui:plant.panel.view3d}}.
stages.checkpoint: The required scenario is named three-axis-palletizing and contains {{assertions}} assertions.

stages.title: Observe
stages.body: Watch the three axes in the trace come to their commands one after the other, and the boxes fill the 2 by 2 pattern in the {{ui:plant.panel.view3d}}.
stages.checkpoint: No box drops, the second layer rests on the first, and Green is on at the end.

stages.title: Reflect
stages.body: A pattern is arithmetic: the slot and the layer come from one counter, so eight boxes need one sequence and not eight. The scenario proves that boxes were placed and rest on pallet 0, that some were sent, that nothing was dropped and that Green is on at the end. It cannot read a position, so it does not check your counts or that the pattern is exactly eight boxes.
stages.checkpoint: What the assertions check is tested; nothing else is.

hints.text: Write Arrived as the comparison of the three positions with their commands within one count, and let every state that moves wait for it.
Use Cycle MOD 4 for the slot and Cycle < 4 for the layer, and send the next box only when the pad is clear of the belt.

faultCases: The starter commands no position, so the gantry stays on the floor; send each box, grip it, place it on the pallet in a 2 by 2 pattern of two layers, and light Green after the eighth.
